convert_dcae_checkpoint_to_diffusers: run the script to convert a DCAE checkpoint from mit-han-lab to a diffusers AutoencoderDC model and save it
convert_ae_function: call convert_ae with a config name and dtype to download and convert a DCAE checkpoint into an AutoencoderDC instance
get_ae_config_function: call get_ae_config with a config name like dc-ae-f32c32-sana-1.0 to retrieve the corresponding AutoencoderDC architecture config dict
remap_qkv_state_dict: call remap_qkv_ to split a combined QKV weight tensor into separate to_q, to_k, and to_v weights in a state dict
get_state_dict_function: call get_state_dict to unwrap nested model, module, or state_dict keys from a saved checkpoint dictionary
